key_indicators: S&P 500 futures rose 0.55% in premarket trading on July 21, 2026, indicating a positive start to the trading day.
The ADP Employment Change Weekly report is due on July 21, 2026, which will provide insights into the private sector labor market.
Nvidia (NVDA), Micron Technology (MU), and Broadcom (AVGO) were trading higher in premarket on July 21, 2026, suggesting strength in the semiconductor sector.
The 10-year Treasury yield was at 4.59% and the two-year yield was at 4.20% on July 21, 2026.
Asian markets mostly gained on July 21, 2026, with Japan's Nikkei 225 up 3.3% and Hong Kong's Hang Seng up 0.2%.
catalysts: European stock indices declined by 0.2% on July 21, 2026, due to escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and anticipation of the ECB's interest rate decision.
Oil prices fell on July 21, 2026, with Brent crude down 0.2% to $89.06 and WTI up 0.2% to $82.66, as mediation efforts between the U.S. and Iran offered hope for de-escalation.
Danaher Corporation (DHR) announced strong second-quarter 2026 results, with net earnings up 60% year-over-year to $870 million, leading to increased full-year guidance.
KeyCorp (KEY) reported second-quarter earnings of $0.44 per share, beating estimates, and revenues of $1.96 billion, slightly missing estimates.
Halliburton Company (HAL) announced second-quarter 2026 results, including net income of $0.64 per diluted share and revenues of $5.7 billion.
Semiconductor stocks showed a rebound on July 21, 2026, with the PHLX Semiconductor Sector Index ETF (SOXQ) jumping 4.27% in premarket trading.
Citigroup advised investors to shift focus from the 'Magnificent Seven' to a broader 'Growth Cluster' for AI investment opportunities due to declining correlation among the tech giants.
The US and European equity index futures are attempting to rebound on July 21, 2026, with the US500 up around 0.4%, though market sentiment remains fragile due to the ongoing U.S.-Iran conflict.
headlines: Asian stocks rise as Middle East mediation eases oil prices, while tech stocks rebound.
US stock futures advance as investors anticipate a busy earnings week and monitor geopolitical tensions.
European markets decline amid geopolitical concerns and upcoming ECB decisions, with oil prices showing mixed movements.
